WITH source_company AS ( SELECT issuer.s_info_windcode AS security_code ,issuer.s_info_compcode AS company_code ,issuer.s_info_compname AS company_name ,issuer.s_info_typecode AS relation_type_code ,CASE issuer.s_info_typecode WHEN 115004000 THEN 1 WHEN 115203000 THEN 2 WHEN 115200000 THEN 3 WHEN 115201000 THEN 4 END AS relation_sort_no ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY issuer.s_info_windcode, issuer.s_info_compcode, issuer.s_info_typecode ORDER BY issuer.opdate DESC ) AS row_num FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_cbondissuer issuer WHERE issuer.s_info_windcode IN
#{code}
AND issuer.s_info_compcode IS NOT NULL AND issuer.s_info_compcode != '' AND issuer.s_info_typecode IN (115004000, 115203000, 115200000, 115201000) )
,eligible_company AS ( SELECT security_code ,company_code ,company_name ,relation_type_code ,relation_sort_no FROM source_company WHERE row_num = 1 )
,ranked_grade AS ( SELECT grade.windcode ,grade.windname ,grade.total_score ,grade.ts ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY grade.windcode ORDER BY grade.ts DESC ) AS row_num FROM ais_inv_analysis.v_inv_grade_result grade WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM eligible_company eligible WHERE eligible.company_code = grade.windcode ) )
,ranked_outer_rating AS ( SELECT rating.s_info_compcode , rating.b_info_creditrating , rating.b_info_creditratingagency , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY rating.s_info_compcode ORDER BY rating.ann_dt DESC , rating.opdate DESC , rating.object_id DESC ) AS row_num FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_cbondissuerrating rating WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dict_external_rating_agency agency WHERE agency.is_deleted = 0 AND agency.b_info_creditratingagency = rating.b_info_creditratingagency ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM eligible_company candidate WHERE candidate.company_code = rating.s_info_compcode ) )
SELECT eligible.security_code ,eligible.company_code ,COALESCE(grade.windname, eligible.company_name) AS company_name ,eligible.relation_type_code ,grade.total_score AS inner_rating ,grade.ts AS rating_time , outer_rating.b_info_creditrating AS rating_bondissuer , outer_rating.b_info_creditratingagency AS rating_bondissuer_agency FROM eligible_company eligible LEFT JOIN ranked_grade grade ON grade.windcode = eligible.company_code AND grade.row_num = 1 LEFT JOIN ranked_outer_rating outer_rating ON outer_rating.s_info_compcode = eligible.company_code AND outer_rating.row_num = 1 ORDER BY eligible.security_code ASC , eligible.relation_sort_no ASC ,grade.ts DESC ,eligible.company_code ASC
